is a {{Skl|Combat}} [[Locations|Location]]. It replaces the {{Zone|Blazing Fortress}}; however, it is meant to be a more difficult Combat Island than {{Zone|The End}}, with most of the mobs having several millions of {{Stat|health}}. {{ZoneText|Battle against brutal mobs!|Collect exotic resources like Spores, Thornleaf, Nether Wart, and more!|Visit the &eDojo&f.|Defeat &cKuudra&f.}} == Location == The Crimson Isle can be accessed only after the player has attained {{Skill|combat|22}}. It is traveled to by the use of a [[Launch Pad (structure)|Launch Pad]] found in the back of the {{Zone|Spiders Den}}. There are 21 main sub-location: {{Zone|Barbarian Outpost}}, {{Zone|The Bastion}}, {{Zone|Blazing Volcano}}, {{Zone|Burning Desert}}, {{Zone|Cathedral}}, {{Zone|Crimson Fields}}, {{Zone|Dojo}}, {{Zone|Dragontail}}, {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}, {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}, {{Zone|Mage Outpost}}, {{Zone|Magma Chamber}}, {{Zone|Mystic Marsh}}, {{Zone|Odger's Hut}}, {{Zone|Ruins of Ashfang}}, {{Zone|Scarleton}}, {{Zone|Stronghold}}, {{Zone|The Wasteland}}, {{Zone|Matriarch's Lair}}, {{Zone|Belly of the Beast}}, and {{Zone|Aura's Lab}}. == Features == === Factions === [[Faction]]s are a new feature of the Crimson Isle. Players can gain reputation with Factions by killing mobs or doing quests (including [[Elle]]'s main questline), giving access to special Items and features. There are two factions: the Barbarian Faction and the Mage Faction. ==== Guards ==== Guards patrol the cities of important Factions. They are passive, but become hostile when attacked. === Bosses === Minibosses and the Magma Boss spawn around the island. They drop rare loot and spawn quickly after they are killed. Similar to the [[End Stone Protector]] they will leave iron blocks near death. Minibosses include the [[Magma Boss]], [[Mage Outlaw]], [[Bladesoul]], [[Ashfang]] and [[Barbarian Duke X]]. ==== Bladesoul ==== [[Bladesoul]] is the first boss of the Crimson Isle. It spawns in the {{Zone|Stronghold}} every 2 minutes after it is killed. It has {{Stat|health|50,000,000}}. ==== Magma Boss ==== {{Main|Magma Boss}} The [[Magma Boss]] will spawn in the {{Zone|Magma Chamber}} every 5 minutes after it is killed. It has {{Stat|health|200,000,000}}. ==== Mage Outlaw ==== The [[Mage Outlaw]] spawns in the {{Zone|Courtyard}} near {{Zone|Scarleton}} every 2 minutes after it is killed. It has {{Stat|health|70,000,000}}. ==== Barbarian Duke X ==== The [[Barbarian Duke X]] spawns in the {{Zone|The Dukedom}} near {{Zone|Dragontail}} every 2 minutes after it is killed. It has {{Stat|health|70,000,000}}. ==== Ashfang ==== [[Ashfang]] will spawn in the {{Zone|Ruins of Ashfang}} every 2 minutes after it is killed. It has {{Stat|health|50,000,000}}, having the least health of all the minibosses, however is a more complicated fight, usually requiring more than one player to defeat it. === Kuudra === {{Main|Kuudra}} [[Kuudra]] is a 4-player fight against a boss, similar to [[Dungeons]]. It takes place in {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}, and drops unique loot. === Vanquishers === {{Main|Vanquisher}} Vanquishers are similar to Special [[Zealot]]s and are mini-withers that have {{stat|hp|5,000,000}}, which have a small chance to spawn after killing any mob in the '''Crimson Isle'''. They drop [[Nether Star]]s, which are used to buy [[Kuudra Keys]] from the Emissaries in each of the [[Faction]]s' settlements. === Fishing === The fishing mechanic in the Crimson Isle is different from the other islands. {{stat|fishing_speed}} is capped at 350 instead of 300. {{skill|fishing|10}} is needed to fish in the {{zone|Crimson Isle}} as the [[Starter Lava Rod]] has that requirement. ==== Trophy Fishing ==== {{Main|Odger|Trophy Fish}} When fishing under a condition, Trophy Fishes can be caught. Trophy Fishes comes with a "rarity" of {{dark Gray|Bronze}}, {{gray|Silver}}, {{yellow|Gold}} and {{aqua|Diamond}}. {{stat|Trophy Chance}} can increase the chance of catching Trophy Fishes. ==== Lava Sea Creatures ==== {{Main|Sea Creatures#List of Sea Creatures}} The Crimson Isle has exclusive [[Sea Creatures]], including the following: *{{MobSprite|Magma Slug}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|27}} *{{MobSprite|Moogma}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|28}} *{{MobSprite|Lava Leech}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|30}} *{{MobSprite|Pyroclastic Worm}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|31}} *{{MobSprite|Lava Flame}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|32}} *{{MobSprite|Fire Eel}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|34}} *{{MobSprite|Taurus}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|35}} *{{MobSprite|Thunder}}: Requires {{skill|fishing|36}} and Novice Trophy Hunter *{{MobSprite|Lord Jawbus}} Requires {{skill|fishing|45}} and Adept Trophy Hunter Additionally, {{Green|6}} Lava Sea Creatures are exclusive to [[Hotspot]]s. * {{MobSprite|Fried Chicken}}: Requires {{Skl|Fishing 14}} * {{MobSprite|Volcanic Snail}}: Requires {{Skl|Fishing 17}} * {{MobSprite|Fireproof Witch}}: Requires {{Skl|Fishing 22}} * {{MobSprite|Magma Pillar}}: Requires {{Skl|Fishing 31}} * {{MobSprite|Fiery Scuttler}}: Requires {{Skl|Fishing 37}} * {{MobSprite|Ragnarok}}: Requires {{Skl|Fishing 47}} == Zones == {{:Locations/Crimson Isle}} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} ==Trivia== *Before the Crimson Isle was opened on the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]], its [[Launch Pad (structure)|Launch Pad]] would display the following text:
{{Dialogue|&cOpening In &k.... &r&cbusiness days}} *The Crimson Isle was the second Alpha Hypixel Network update to feature the Equipment types [[Necklaces]], [[Cloaks]], [[Belts]], [[Gloves]] and [[Bracelets]]. *The Crimson Isle features are the second ever to use [[Loot Sharing]], the first being the [[Ghost]]. **All of SkyBlock now uses [[Loot Sharing]]. *The Crimson Isle is based on the Vanilla [[mcw:The Nether|Nether]] dimension. **The name of the island is likely named after the Vanilla [[mcw:Crimson Forest|Crimson Forest Nether biome]]. *The Crimson Isle is believed to be related to the Catacombs. **Ashfang and Thorn have a similar attack pattern. Both of them only take damage from hits of their minions' death. They don't attack by themselves. Instead, they fight with minions. **Magma Boss and The Wither Lords have a similar attack pattern as well. Both of them spawn crowds of minions that deals massive damage. They also both deal high damage. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/February 22|link=none|Added '''Crimson Isle'''.
